skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and respond to spoken English in everyday contexts.
Communicate effectively in English on familiar topics.
Expand vocabulary related to common topics such as society, food, business, trends, success, pressure, environment, and health.
Apply grammatical structures in spoken English.
Analyze and solve problems using critical thinking skills.
Work effectively in groups and independently.
Deliver short presentations on course topics.
Prepare for IELTS Speaking and Listening tests at the 5.0-5.5 level.
